purpose: Test three fixed hybrid-majority ordinal profiles on fresh E91-E95: preserve the strongest V11 completion proxy as three votes and add exactly one FaaSRank, load-faithful Orion, or Jiagu current-demand vote; all 60 runs remain blinded until QC and pairing complete.

fresh_development_cohort.reason: E91-E95 were declared in the V35 full source manifest but were never captured, referenced, executed, or inspected; E21-E90 are closed and E11-E20 remain sealed.

source.high_profile_note: Frozen high remains 7k; V36 is low only.

diagnostic_basis.strong_rollback: V11 remains the strongest low-load rollback point: on E01-E03 it ranked second in both mean throughput and mean QPR, only 0.11% and 0.42% below Hiku.
diagnostic_basis.closed_v34_v35_observation: Direct expert replacement and FaaSRank/Orion/LoadLeast Borda profiles were unstable on E81-E90. Those closed cohorts do not answer whether the successful V11 hybrid ordering should remain dominant while one exact baseline-semantic expert supplies a minority vote.
diagnostic_basis.bounded_follow_up: Convert the unchanged V11 scalar penalty and one expert penalty into deterministic ordinal ranks. Repeat the V11 rank exactly three times and the expert rank once, using the existing Borda sum, worst-rank tie-break, and final node-ID tie-break.
diagnostic_basis.vote_rationale: Three-to-one is the smallest fixed integer profile in this study that gives the proven hybrid proxy a strict three-quarter supermajority over one expert. It introduces no fitted continuous threshold or coefficient.

expert_controls.FaaSRank: deterministic exploitation score copied from the frozen calibrated baseline
expert_controls.load_faithful_OrionP: frozen Orion weights with pending plus running plus projected load
expert_controls.Jiagu: current-demand exact container/utilization/load ordering without forecast fitting

diagnostic_basis.player_order: All three candidates retain V11's deterministic player order; expert-specific critical-path, demand, and forecast ordering is not enabled.

router_inputs: current pending and running task counts
current DAG parent placement and frozen function/resource attributes

development_matrix.result_blind_execution_order: Commit before capture; build and run serially; reveal after all QC and pairing.

eligibility_per_candidate: mean fixed-window throughput strictly exceeds all nine baseline means
mean QPR strictly exceeds all nine baseline means
frozen V8 middle/high retain first place in both metrics
selection_rule: Freeze the first passing candidate in fixed v36a, v36b, v36c priority (FaaSRank QPR control, Orion throughput control, Jiagu independent current-demand control); ties fail; otherwise select none and close E91-E95.

confirmation.closure_requirement: First in mean throughput and QPR for every load against frozen E11-E20 baselines.
